reviews.text: Thank you so much, Maria, for your patience and understanding with Bourbon. We are delighted with the experience. I contacted Maria because my dog ​​was becoming reactive with other dogs and cats. From day one, she demonstrated endless patience, a deep understanding of canine communication, and a method based on respect and positive reinforcement. She not only helped Bourbon but also gave us the tools and confidence to understand him better. 100% recommended!

Maria is amazing; she's helped us so much with our border collie, Roma. She had stalking problems and reacted badly to other dogs. We'd already been to several trainers, but none of them helped us like Maria, who understood the problem from the very first minute and created an incredible connection with Roma. We're so happy with the result!
Maria taught Bella to answer the call, and I can see that Bella has improved. I recommend it!

Maria is a wonderful person who has helped us a lot in getting to know our dog and managing her properly. Now walks are a pleasure, as she has taught us techniques for controlling her during walks, as well as how to anticipate situations that might upset her. We're so lucky to have found her.

When we started working with Maria, Maxi wouldn't stay alone for even half a second. With the training and guidance, we've seen incredible improvement. It's a process of patience and discipline for both Maxi and us as his owners; but Maria's guidance has undoubtedly been essential and rewarding throughout this time! Thank you so much!

I started working with Maria because my dog, Alai, is very nervous and reacted strongly in public. We had been working with another trainer and hadn't made much progress.
With Maria, everything was fantastic from day one. Alai fell in love with her and adores her. We both love the exercises she gives us, and he has improved tremendously both in public and in his interactions with other dogs.
Maria corrects our exercises every day and answers any questions we might have.
We are both thrilled! It's wonderful being her student!
Thank you so much for everything. Thanks to you, Jackson and I have learned to know and understand each other. He was a good boy, but thanks to you, he's even better now.

It has been a pleasure working with Maria; she was exactly what we were looking for.
She has been very attentive to both us and our dog, adapting to our needs at all times. The classes are dynamic, both at home and outdoors. She has helped us a lot to understand Linda and manage her behavior; beyond the basic commands, she has taught us how to make walks more stimulating for both of us, how to make it fun for her, and how to arrive home calm. Thanks to all the classes, we have bonded even more with our dog.
On top of that, Maria is lovely, and Linda adores her.
100% recommended, and we will definitely stay in touch. Thank you so much!

I want to share my experience because it has truly been a game-changer in my relationship with my one-year-old dog.

From the very first moment, she demonstrated great professionalism, but also something equally important: patience, empathy, and a very respectful approach to the animal. She perfectly understood my dog's personality and adapted the training to her needs, something not everyone can do.

Thanks to her work, my dog ​​now responds much better to commands, is calmer, and, above all, happier. What I value most is that she not only trained my pet but also taught me how to communicate better with her, understand her behavior, and reinforce what she learned every day.

The change has been remarkable in a very short time, and the process has always been positive, without stress or aggressive methods. It's clear she loves what she does and has a wealth of experience.

Without a doubt, I wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone who wants to improve their relationship with their dog and strengthen their bond. An exceptional professional!

We started working with Maria when Hoop was 4 months old, and it was a fantastic decision. From the beginning, Hoop learned little by little through play, affection, and lots of rewards. Week after week, she progressed, adding a bit more difficulty to the exercises, first at home and then outside. Seeing how she has grown throughout the process and how she has integrated her learning into each walk has been a very positive experience for both her and us. Working with her every day has brought us much closer, and in addition to what we've learned, it's an excellent way to strengthen our bond with her. We would do it again without hesitation.
